Checking one last thing: whether the other new tools are registered in `main.py`. I'm not editing anything. I also couldn't run the new test file because the sandbox blocked `pytest`, so the findings come from reading the code only.

VERDICT: ISSUES
1. `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_work_history.py:26` and `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs.py:27`: the plan table in `docs/feature/wp2.md` (lines 39 and 42) and the acceptance criteria say the tools return `list[...]`. Both tools return a wrapper object instead, `{entries: [...]}` and `{requests: [...]}`. WP3 depends on these output shapes. The wrapper may be unavoidable, since `mindmap_work_list` also uses an object (`WorkItemListOutput`), but the plan and the code disagree and nothing documents the choice.
2. `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_work_history.py:65`: the extra query for `stage_before`, `stage_after` and `workflow_id` filters only on `memory_id` and `tenant_id`, not on the map or team. A history entry whose id is missing from `stages` gets `None` for all three fields without any error. The test covers the happy path only, so a mismatch would pass unnoticed.
3. `src/mem_mcp/mindmap/work_items.py:1413`, `src/mem_mcp/mindmap/workflow_moves.py:56` and `src/mem_mcp/audit/logger.py:92`: these changes are outside the T8 file list. They add `workflow_id` and `current_stage` to `list_work_items`, add `signoff_roles` to `WorkflowSignoffRequest`, and add a `mindmap.workflow` audit action. They look like leftovers from other tasks. They change shared interfaces and should be split out or justified.
4. `tests/integration/test_mindmap_work_history_pending_e2e.py:96`: the role-restriction test only shows that admin can sign and that member and owner cannot. It never checks that a member is excluded only because of the role restriction, because the unrestricted case isn't compared in the same setup. It also has no test for `team_id=None` defaulting, a non-member caller, or a request already cancelled or committed. That is thin coverage of the "for the caller" requirement.
5. `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_work_history.py:35`: the two new tool classes aren't registered in `src/mem_mcp/main.py`. `MindmapWorkflowSignoffTool` isn't registered there either, so registration may be planned as separate work. Until it's done, neither tool is reachable through the dispatcher that WP3 uses.
